def z_for_radius(radius):
    # Practice-sheet calibration: radius 1.1 mm at 0.018 m, 3.2 at 0.012,
    # 8 at 0.006. A 0.4 mm join stays just inside the paper surface.
    r=float(radius)
    if r<=1.1:return .0196-(r-.4)/.7*.0016
    if r<=3.2:return .018-(r-1.1)/(3.2-1.1)*.006
    return .012-(r-3.2)/(8.-3.2)*.006

def wp(row,col,z):
    x=X_FAR-(float(row)+.5)*PAPER/N
    y=Y_LEFT-(float(col)+.5)*PAPER/N
    return [x,y,float(z)]+Q

def well(c,z):
    # c is zero-based colour index; each column has five wells.
    x=-.16+.03*(c%5)
    y=.14 if c<5 else .17
    return [x,y,z]+Q

def trajectory(stroke):
    path=stroke['path']
    first=path[0];last=path[-1]
    a=[wp(first[0],first[1],HOVER)]*4
    a += [wp(first[0],first[1],z_for_radius(first[2]))]*3
    a += [wp(p[0],p[1],z_for_radius(p[2])) for p in path[1:]]
    a += [wp(last[0],last[1],HOVER)]*4
    return a

                print('IK failure',note,res.meta['plan'],flush=True)
